name: Moonwell mMAMO donated-underlying exchange-rate inflation
summary: mMAMO derives its exchange rate from the market's own MAMO balance, so underlying transferred straight to the market is credited to every existing share while minting none, which the Comptroller's 20,000,000 mint-path supply cap cannot restrain. The attacker accrued interest, read the rate, and transferred 34,910,396.684792645 MAMO into the market in one transaction, then 18,482,893.625840746 more, lifting the stored rate from 205132568127692808921476270 to 754603632406632280153424515 - 3.68 times - against unchanged share supply, and borrowed cbBTC, WETH, USDC, and wstETH against the revalued collateral without repaying.
notes: MIP-B48 listing: the Comptroller's markets(mMAMO) record moved from unlisted with zero collateral factor to listed with a 50 percent factor, emitting MarketListed for mMAMO in the same transaction. This is the later of the two resets - the delegator activated implementation 0x1fadff493529c3fcc7ee04f1f15d19816dda45b7 in its own creation block, 447,556 seconds earlier - because listing made the donation-sensitive exchange rate collateral the Comptroller would lend against.

Moonwell's official post-mortem reconciles $11,028,761.70 of gross borrows across 18 transactions (71.35549505 cbBTC, 623.600287604679454542 WETH, 2,560,000 USDC, 368 wstETH at borrow-block oracles) against 595 liquidation events repaying 17.76122375 cbBTC, 38.573335900949439222 WETH, 215,841.545449 USDC, and 25.307914898863610231 wstETH, leaving $9,131,342 of residual borrower obligations as the permanent pool shortfall. Liquidators repaid out of the attacker's own seized MAMO collateral, so gross victim depletion cannot be isolated from that recovery and the measurement is net. Scope: the residual covers the whole campaign, including five cbBTC borrows totalling 7.79270388 of the 71.35549505 cbBTC (about $622,000 at the borrow-block cbBTC oracle) that preceded the first donation and were carried by the MAMO feed's rise alone; the evidence does not support splitting the shortfall per borrow. The attacker's $1,947,391 seed USDC and its 68,482,886 supplied and directly transferred MAMO are attacker-supplied campaign inputs, not victim depletion. The attempted 2,000,000 AERO borrow transferred nothing and is excluded.

One fault episode: both donations, all 18 borrows, and the 595 liquidations belong to this incident, anchored on the first donation rather than on the first borrow. The linked operational account 0xd71dd9b6e634412713c47fe7ae02c628e338c384 supplied seed financing and received the consolidated DAI, and is named as an attacker address for campaign completeness.
